behavior: A raw POSIX installer stream installs a checksum-verified selected release outside a checkout.
Native installers resolve and validate a latest release when no checkout pin is available.
Installer failures preserve the prior binary and fail visibly.
Documentation distinguishes native release recovery from checkout bootstrap.
